LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 10.3.1 PREPOSITIONS ▪ NEXT TO, ▪ AROUND, ▪ NEAR, ▪ BY, ▪ ALONG, ▪ AFTER, ▪ UNDER

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions ▪ next to, ▪ around, ▪ near, ▪ by, ▪ along, ▪ after, ▪ under
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions ▪ next to, ▪ around, ▪ near, ▪ by, ▪ along, ▪ after, ▪ under, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you describe the position of something?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions ▪ next to, ▪ around, ▪ near, ▪ by, ▪ along, ▪ after, ▪ under together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to speak clearly and effectively is improved as they use prepositions to describe the

position, location and direction of things.

• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s teamwork spirit is enhanced as they construct sentences with peers using prepositions and give

feedback.

Values:
Social justice is inculcated as the learner fosters inclusivity and non-discrimination to peers as they play language games featuring prepositions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they perfect the use prepositions in communication.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner applies the knowledge acquired on prepositions to learning of similar concepts in Kiswahili Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Print textbooks in appropriate font size and colour contrast

● Braille books

● Digital devices with assistive technology,

● Pictures or picture description
